s1.syndrome_frame: Acute loss of consciousness with trauma and near-syncope episodes in an elderly patient with a history of hypertension
salient_findings: Episode of syncope with head and left shoulder pain
Near-fainting spells in the week prior to the index event
Mild concentric left ventricular hypertrophy with preserved left ventricular systolic function
key_facts: Patient is in their 80s
History of hypertension controlled with Dyazide
Presented with 1 episode of syncope
Felt hot and light-headed before the syncopal event
Had a few near-fainting spells in the week prior to the index event
Vital signs were stable without considerable orthostatic changes
Serum electrolyte levels and cardiac enzymes were normal
Cranial CT showed no acute pathologic changes
Echocardiogram showed mild concentric left ventricular hypertrophy with preserved left ventricular systolic function
ECG showed sinus rhythm with right bundle-branch block and fascicular block
